title: 哈佛经济学家：AI转型先别谈增长，但谁来定义意义？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: The world is facing a major transition to artificial intelligence, with some predicting Nirvana and others fearing disaster.
segments.zh: 世界正面临人工智能的重大转型，有人预测乌托邦，有人担忧灾难。

segments.en: 250 years ago, Adam Smith advocated for the role of markets to improve the lives of all citizens, but also recognize the need for government to structure those markets.
segments.zh: 250年前，亚当·斯密倡导市场在改善公民生活中的作用，但也认识到政府需要构建市场。

segments.en: Harvard's Jason Furman has worked on getting that balance right, both as an economist at Harvard and as President Obama's Senior Economic Advisor.
segments.zh: 哈佛大学的杰森·弗曼致力于平衡这两者，他既是哈佛经济学家，也曾是奥巴马总统的高级经济顾问。

segments.en: Artificial intelligence, the investment and the expectation of it is driving the markets and even parts of the economy at this point.
segments.zh: 人工智能及其**预期正在推动市场，甚至部分经济领域。

segments.en: One of the questions is, do we just let them play, let them go as far as they want, as fast as they want, or do we have some regulation?
segments.zh: 问题之一是，我们是放任其自由发展，还是需要一些监管？

segments.en: I mean, Adam Smith is known for the wealth nations, and his thought is a free market here, but as you've you've written, there was another book he wrote, not moral sentiments, that also said, you've got to do this for the good of everybody.
segments.zh: 亚当·斯密以《国富论》闻名，主张自由市场，但正如你所写，他还写了另一本书，也强调要为大众利益而行动。

segments.en: Where do we get the balance? Yeah, it's funny. When I think of AI, in some ways, I almost start with morality.
segments.zh: 我们如何取得平衡？有趣的是，当我想到人工智能时，我几乎从道德开始。

segments.en: Not what's it going to do to economic growth, what's it going to do to inflation, but what's it going to do to our sense of meaning and purpose,
segments.zh: 不是它对经济增长或通胀有何影响，而是它对我们意义感和目标感的影响。

segments.en: and how we think of ourselves as human beings?
segments.zh: 以及我们如何认识自己作为人类。

segments.en: It's a technology that has incredible upsides in every dimension, but it also has very big downsides in every dimension.
segments.zh: 这项技术在各个方面都有巨大的优势，但同样也有巨大的劣势。
